spec.title: Tuple Operations RPS
spec.description: Показывает RPS нагрузки по tuple operations: insert/update/delete/fetch/return.

spec.expr:
sum by (instance, datname, operation) (
    label_replace(rate(pg_stat_database_tup_inserted{instance=~"${dbInstances:regex}", datname=~"${dbNames:regex}"}[5m]), "operation", "inserted", "__name__", ".*")
  )
  or
  sum by (instance, datname, operation) (
    label_replace(rate(pg_stat_database_tup_updated{instance=~"${dbInstances:regex}", datname=~"${dbNames:regex}"}[5m]), "operation", "updated", "__name__", ".*")
  )
  or
  sum by (instance, datname, operation) (
    label_replace(rate(pg_stat_database_tup_deleted{instance=~"${dbInstances:regex}", datname=~"${dbNames:regex}"}[5m]), "operation", "deleted", "__name__", ".*")
  )
  or
  sum by (instance, datname, operation) (
    label_replace(rate(pg_stat_database_tup_fetched{instance=~"${dbInstances:regex}", datname=~"${dbNames:regex}"}[5m]), "operation", "fetched", "__name__", ".*")
  )
  or
  sum by (instance, datname, operation) (
    label_replace(rate(pg_stat_database_tup_returned{instance=~"${dbInstances:regex}", datname=~"${dbNames:regex}"}[5m]), "operation", "returned", "__name__", ".*")
  )

spec.title: Memory
spec.description: Breakdown of physical memory and swap usage. Hardware-detected memory errors are also displayed

spec.legendFormat: Apps - Memory used by user-space applications
PageTables - Memory used to map between virtual and physical memory addresses
SwapCache - Memory that keeps track of pages that have been fetched from swap but not yet been modified
Slab - Memory used by the kernel to cache data structures for its own use (caches like inode, dentry, etc)
Cache - Parked file data (file content) cache
Hardware Corrupted - Amount of RAM that the kernel identified as corrupted / not working

matcher.options: Hardware Corrupted - Amount of RAM that the kernel identified as corrupted / not working

spec.title: CPU
spec.description: CPU time usage split by state, normalized across all CPU cores

spec.legendFormat: System - Processes executing in kernel mode
User - Normal processes executing in user mode
Nice - Niced processes executing in user mode
Iowait - Waiting for I/O to complete
Steal - Time spent in other operating systems when running in a virtualized environment
Idle - Waiting for something to happen

spec.expr: sum by(instance) (rate(node_cpu_guest_seconds_total{instance="$nodeInstance",job="$nodeJob"}[$__rate_interval])) / on(instance) group_left sum by (instance)((rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{instance="$nodeInstance",job="$nodeJob"}[$__rate_interval]))) > 0

matcher.options: Idle - Waiting for something to happen
Iowait - Waiting for I/O to complete
Nice - Niced processes executing in user mode
Steal - Time spent in other operating systems when running in a virtualized environment
System - Processes executing in kernel mode
User - Normal processes executing in user mode

spec.title: Gateway RPS vs Symfony RPS
spec.description:
сточник: API Gateway + Symfony application
  Metrics: nginx_vts_server_requests_total, symfony_request_durations_histogram_seconds_count, catalog_request_durations_histogram_seconds_count

  sum by (layer) (
    label_replace(
      rate(nginx_vts_server_requests_total{job="api-gateway-vts", host="*", code=~"[1-5]xx"}[5m]),
      "layer",
      "API Gateway incoming RPS",
      "job",
      ".*"
    )
  )
  or
  sum by (layer) (
    label_replace(
      rate(
        {
          __name__=~"(symfony_request_durations_histogram_seconds_count|catalog_request_durations_histogram_seconds_count)",
          job=~"symfony-http|catalog-http|cart-http",
          action="all"
        }[5m]
      ),
      "layer",
      "Symfony application RPS",
      "job",
      ".*"
    )
  )

  Показывает: две разные точки измерения трафика.
  Labels: layer
  Unit: req/s
  Visualization: Time series
  Ограничения: значения не обязаны совпадать 1:1.

spec.expr:
sum by (layer) (
    label_replace(
      rate(nginx_vts_server_requests_total{job="api-gateway-vts", host="*", code=~"[1-5]xx"}[5m]),
      "layer",
      "API Gateway incoming RPS",
      "job",
      ".*"
    )
  ) or
  sum by (layer) (
    label_replace(
      rate(
        {
          __name__=~"(.+_request_durations_histogram_seconds_count)",
          job=~"(${services:regex})-${suffix}",
          action="all"
        }[5m]
      ),
      "layer",
      "Symfony application RPS",
      "job",
      ".*"
    )
  )

spec.title: Errors API Gateway (процент внешних HTTP responses классов 4xx и 5xx.)
spec.description:
Источник: API Gateway
  Metrics: nginx_vts_server_requests_total

  100 *
  (
    (
      sum(rate(nginx_vts_server_requests_total{job="api-gateway-vts", host="*", code=~"4xx|5xx"}[5m]))
      or vector(0)
    )
    /
    clamp_min(
      sum(rate(nginx_vts_server_requests_total{job="api-gateway-vts", host="*", code=~"[1-5]xx"}[5m])),
      0.000000001
    )
  )

  Показывает: процент внешних HTTP responses классов 4xx и 5xx.
  Labels: none
  Unit: percent (0-100)
  Visualization: Stat или Gauge
  Ограничения: это gateway error %, не Symfony application error %. Для Symfony сейчас нет 5xx metrics.

spec.expr:
100 *
  (
    (
      sum(rate(nginx_vts_server_requests_total{job="api-gateway-vts", host="*", code=~"4xx|5xx"}[5m]))
      or vector(0)
    )
    /
    clamp_min(
      sum(rate(nginx_vts_server_requests_total{job="api-gateway-vts", host="*", code=~"[1-5]xx"}[5m])),
      0.000000001
    )
  )
spec.legendFormat: процент внешних HTTP responses классов 4xx и 5xx.

spec.title: Approx Avg Execution Time Per Tuple Operation
spec.description: Показывает грубую оценку active SQL time на одну tuple operation.

spec.expr:
sum by (instance, datname) (
    rate(pg_stat_database_active_time_seconds_total{instance=~"${dbInstances:regex}", datname=~"${dbNames:regex}"}[5m])
  )
  /
  clamp_min(
    sum by (instance, datname) (
      rate(pg_stat_database_tup_inserted{instance=~"${dbInstances:regex}", datname=~"${dbNames:regex}"}[5m])
    +
      rate(pg_stat_database_tup_updated{instance=~"${dbInstances:regex}", datname=~"${dbNames:regex}"}[5m])
    +
      rate(pg_stat_database_tup_deleted{instance=~"${dbInstances:regex}", datname=~"${dbNames:regex}"}[5m])
    +
      rate(pg_stat_database_tup_fetched{instance=~"${dbInstances:regex}", datname=~"${dbNames:regex}"}[5m])
    ),
    0.000000001
  )
